name: Benchmark for JSON-to-JSON Transformations
description: This dataset provides a reusable benchmark for evaluating JSON-to-JSON transformations with large language models and other transformation systems. It contains 456 test cases covering 38 transformation recipes, four input sizes (n = 2, 4, 8, and 16 logical records), and three sampling seeds (13, 17, and 23). The cases are derived from 12 archived source profiles obtained from 11 public APIs. The tasks cover field selection and renaming, flattening and nesting, type conversion, filtering, grouping, aggregation, and relationship processing. Each case includes input JSON, explicit transformation rules, a target JSON Schema, reference output, and source-schema variants. The package includes source snapshots, reference and scoring code, an offline command-line helper, and documentation. Researchers can use these materials to test their own transformation systems and compare their results against the provided reference outputs. Fixed inputs and sampling seeds support reproducible comparisons across systems and input sizes.
